[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Iron Horse Mine | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=088 }} The [[Iron Horse Mine]] is large area to the northwest of [[Yak's Bend]] that houses a productive [[Stone Summit]] mine. It likely drew its name from the large amount of mining machinery placed in the mine. The Stone Summit dwarves [[patrol]] only a short distance from their mine entrances, leaving the [[Snow Ettin]]s still roaming along the east and the [[Frostfire Dryder]]s in the west. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== Travel northwest from [[Yak's Bend]] through [[Traveler's Vale]]. Alternatively, travel the northeast from [[Ice Tooth Cave]] via [[Anvil Rock]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *Northwest, at the exit into [[Anvil Rock]]. *Southeast, at the exit into [[Traveler's Vale]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Norin Stonegrimm]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Frostfire Fang]]s) ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 (5) [[Snow Wolf]] (mostly in the northwest) ===Foes=== [[Dryder]]s *{{n}} 10 (24) [[Frostfire Dryder]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) *{{w}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Crusher]] *{{w}} 9 (23) [[Summit Axe Wielder]] *{{w}} 13 (24) [[Summit Beastmaster]] *{{r}} 9 (23) [[Stone Summit Scout]] *{{mo}} 11 (24) [[Dolyak Rider]] *{{n}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Howler]] *{{me}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Sage]] [[Elemental]]s (Stone Summit) *{{e}} 10 (24) [[Ice Golem]] [[Ettin]]s *{{w}} 11 (24) [[Snow Ettin]] [[Minotaur]]s *{{w}} 10 (24) [[Minotaur (Shiverpeaks)|Minotaur]] ====Bosses==== Dryders *{{n}} 12 (27) [[Frostfire Dryder (necromancer boss)|Frostfire Dryder]] *{{me}} 12 (27) [[Frostfire Dryder (mesmer boss)|Frostfire Dryder]] *{{e}} 12 (27) [[Frostfire Dryder (elementalist boss)|Frostfire Dryder]] Dwarves (Stone Summit) *{{w}} 13 (27) [[Fendar Stonestance]] *{{r}} 13 (27) [[Garris Nightwatch]] *{{mo}} 13 (27) [[Shalis Ironmantle]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Iron Horse Mines}} *The [[Minaar's Trouble]], [[Minaar's Worry]], [[Stone Summit Beastmasters]], and [[The Wayward Monk]] quests affect the spawns in this area. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.4% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 180|low = 160|high = 194}} **The [[Dolyak Rider]]s may prove difficult to kill with their use of [[Mark of Protection]]. Consider bringing [[List of enchantment removal skills|enchantment removal]] or [[interrupt]]s; although, it will also work by getting the Dolyak Rider to use Mark of Protection on another foe before focusing on killing the Dolyak Rider. **Consider coming from [[Ice Tooth Cave]] rather than [[Yak's Bend]]. Traveler's Vale contains large numbers of Stone Summit, whereas in Anvil Rock you will face only Minotaurs and a few Frostfire Dryders. **With patience, it is possible to bring a party of eight from [[Temple of the Ages]]. **Some [[Stone Summit]] groups have long patrol paths, so to find them you might need to revisit places you've already cleared. {{Explorable areas in the Northern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Eisenrossmine]]
